source: YouTube auto-caption transcript 0:00-19:15 (tools/video_draft.py transcript iGzTA_-eFbw --start 0 --end 1155); nothing past 19:15 read. 'type' marks each idea as claim, heuristic or one-off pick; 'repeats' lists ideas of earlier videos it restates; 'related' lists looser topic matches. Solo draft: every idea is the host's (speaker field kept for the schema).

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Fatehold Chronologist is a middle ground between power level and flexibility (hybrid), and he takes it over Last Gasp, the best card in the pack, to get more reps with it.
ideas.quote: I think it's kind of like a nice little middle ground between power level and flexibility.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Fatehold Chronologist against Last Gasp.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Rise of the Deathbringer would be better in a faster format: the minus three, minus three kills few relevant creatures; Fblthp, Impossibly Lost is really good with Chronologist.
ideas.quote: I think it'd be better if the format was faster because like the minus three, minus three doesn't kill as many relevant creatures.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Rise of the Deathbringer by game length.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Mind Meanderer is heavy blue, easy to play in blue-green decks and very splashable; it is the best card in a weak pack and the dual land is not helpful.
ideas.quote: I think this is the best card, and it's very splashable.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Mind Meanderer as a splash.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Landcyclers are being taken higher and higher: he used to wheel them at picks eight and nine but that now happens less often; Undulating Witness is taken for flexibility (a blue any-colour deck splashing green).
ideas.quote: I've been finding that the land cyclers are getting taken higher and higher and higher.
ideas.test_idea: Average pick position of landcyclers over time.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Saheeli, Jewel of Avishkar is good if you can build around it with plenty of spells, but it tends to eat removal.
ideas.quote: It does like tend to eat removal spells, so like no admittance is a very good card.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Saheeli, Jewel of Avishkar by noncreature count.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Samut, Hazoret's Champion is very strong when building a more tempo deck: giving random fliers haste.
ideas.quote: Samut's very strong when you're building like a more tempo deck.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Samut, Hazoret's Champion in tempo decks.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: A pair of colours showing up together (all the blue-red cards at pick seven) is the signal that blue-red is open; he does not need to splash the Meanderer.
ideas.quote: Bang, we're getting all the blue red cards now.
ideas.test_idea: Whether a cluster of pair cards at picks 5-7 predicts the pair's flow.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Traxos, Academy Guardian is really good with cheap interaction: play it after an Unsummon and get a three-drop effect.
ideas.quote: You play this after like an unsummon, you get like a three drop effect.
ideas.test_idea: Win rate of Traxos, Academy Guardian with Unsummon in the deck.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: He does not think Artifist Acumen is very good, but with a few two-drops and prowess it might work with two copies and a Blazing Crescendo.
ideas.quote: I really don't think artifist acumen is very good.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Mindseeker Oculus is better than Clash of Elements pound for pound: when you cast it on turn three the game is just so good for you.
ideas.quote: I kind of just don't ever want to pass Mindseeker Oculus. It's just so strong.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Mindseeker Oculus against Clash of Elements.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Commit to splashing green for a heavy-blue card: take the second Mind Meanderer; with the Heartwood token makers or an Improviser you can get green mana.
ideas.quote: Let's just take the Mind Meanderer and just commit to splashing green for him.
ideas.test_idea: Win rate of green splashes for Mind Meanderer.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: The power level tends to be worth pursuing in this format: he prefers power over staying in colours.
ideas.quote: I find that the power level tends to be something worth pursuing a lot of the time in this format.
ideas.test_idea: Does early pick power predict deck win rate better than colour consistency?

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: He does not want the double-green splash: Awaken the Inferno over Craftwork Crusher to stay blue-red; he has done the double splash too often.
ideas.quote: Let's just not go for the double green splash. I've been doing that a lot.
ideas.test_idea: Win rate of double-pip off-colour splashes.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Frostbite Pyromental is the perfect deck for it: card draw deals damage, works well with Fblthp.
ideas.quote: This is actually the perfect deck for Frostbite Pyromancer. Card draw deals damage.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Frostbite Pyromental by card-draw count.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Pia, Determined Rebuilder is much better than Chandra's Emberling, even when he would otherwise take the Emberling: pack 2 pick 9.
ideas.quote: I would take the Chandra's Emberling, but Pia's just so much better.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Pia, Determined Rebuilder against Chandra's Emberling.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Wrath of the Bloodmane over a pack of cheaper cards: 'okay, but Wrath is like actually good'; not a Darklight Phoenix deck.
ideas.quote: This card's like okay. But Wrath is like actually good.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Wrath of the Bloodmane against Darklight Phoenix.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: He builds a tempo version of the deck first, knowing it is worse than the other version, to see what it looks like, then puts in the better version; the weird cards (Emberling, Crescendo) he wants to try are the ones the better version cuts.
ideas.quote: Let's just build a tempo version of the deck and then make the better version.
ideas.test_idea: Win rate of tempo against value builds on the same pool.
